decisions.rationale: 2025 NOA total income of $92,782, pay stub run-rate of $90,500 and letter base salary of $88,984 reasonably support the stated $90,500.
A $15,250 cash deposit on 27 May is unexplained, and without it the balance of about $31,325 is below the $32,000 down payment.
Panel appraiser Lakeshore Appraisal Group values the property at $403,000 versus $400,000 price, report dated 26 June 2026.
Letter dated 31 May 2026 on letterhead, signed by HR, confirms permanent full-time employment, consistent with application.
GDS is about 30% and TDS about 37-39% including the Maple Visa omitted from the worksheet, within 39%/44%, with credit score 745.
